goal: Den dritten und letzten browserlokalen Preview-Viewport ergänzen: Schmal mit 360 Pixeln. Desktop 1152 px bleibt initialer Standard, Tablet 768 px bleibt unverändert, Persistenz bleibt geschlossen.

guide_delta.summary: Die Vorschau erhält zusätzlich zu Desktop 1152 px und Tablet 768 px einen flüchtigen schmalen Modus mit 360 px. Alle drei Modi teilen dieselben Preview-Daten.

direct_dependencies: I139 desktop preview contract is confirmed
I140 tablet preview contract is confirmed
I129 persistence boundary remains plan-only and closed
tests_required: run existing test_browser_shell.py as narrow browser-shell regression
all preview mode buttons expose aria-pressed state
mode switch updates width/label/aria contract without mutating draft data
tests_explicitly_not_run: database/repository tests because no persistence path changes
Control Plane tests because governance is unchanged
full product suite because the change is browser-local and targeted
new Chromium screenshot evidence because this iteration establishes the third viewport contract only
risks: desktop mode must remain the initial default and keep 1152 px
narrow mode must not mutate preview data semantics
aria state and visible mode label must remain synchronized
preview mode must not leak into persistence
non_changes: no JSON schema or SQLite changes
no HTTP write route or browser storage
expected_side_effects: desktop remains the initial preview at 1152 px
narrow preview can be selected at 360 px
the active mode is visible and announced via aria state
